Liiga games

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_games.Rd

Every game of a season and tournament: teams, score, xG, power plays, periods and rink.

Usage

liiga_games(season = NULL, tournament = NULL)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Omitted = the season in progress.

tournament

Tournament: runkosarja (regular season), playoffs, playout, qualifications, valmistavat_ottelut (preseason) or chl (Champions Hockey League). Omitted = every tournament, preseason included.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (59 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
startcharacterScheduled start, ISO 8601 UTC.
endcharacterTime the game ended, ISO 8601 UTC (absent from the refs captures; seen in the full 2026 playoff body).
periodscharacterJSON list of the game's periods: index, home and away goals, category, start and end second.
finished_typecharacterHow the game ended: ENDED_DURING_REGULAR_GAME_TIME, ENDED_DURING_EXTENDED_GAME_TIME (overtime), ENDED_DURING_WINNING_SHOT_COMPETITION (shootout).
startedlogicalGame has started.
endedlogicalGame has ended.
game_timeintegerSeconds from the start of the game. Regular season: 3900 (65:00) = the end of the 5-minute overtime; playoff overtime runs past it.
spectatorsintegerAttendance (spectators) reported for the game.
play_off_pairintegerPlayoff pairing number, else null.
play_off_phaseintegerPlayoff round, else null.
play_off_req_winsintegerWins needed to take the playoff series, else null.
buy_tickets_urlcharacterTicket link for the game, else null.
ice_rink_idintegerLiiga's id of the rink (ice arena).
ice_rink_namecharacterName of the rink (ice arena).
ice_rink_latitudenumericRink latitude, decimal degrees.
ice_rink_longitudenumericRink longitude, decimal degrees.
ice_rink_street_addresscharacterStreet address of the rink.
ice_rink_zipcharacterPostal code of the rink.
ice_rink_citycharacterCity where the rink is located.
current_periodintegerLast period played (3 = regulation; 4 and up = overtime periods or the shootout; 2026 values 3, 4, 5, 7).
stalelogicalLive data is stale.
seriecharacterTournament code, uppercase (RUNKOSARJA, PLAYOFFS, PRACTICE, ...); in /schedule the integer tournament id instead (see serieId and Divergence notes).
game_weekintegerGame week of the season.
home_team_idintegerHome team id (the number of the <num>:<slug> key).
home_team_slugcharacterHome team slug (e.g. hpk).
home_placeholdercharacterHome team: placeholder label for an undecided playoff team, else null.
home_namecharacterHome team: display name of the team, e.g. HPK.
home_goalsintegerHome team: goals scored by the team in the game.
home_time_outintegerHome team: second of the game (from game start) at which the team called its timeout.
home_powerplay_instancesintegerHome team: power plays the team had in the game.
home_powerplay_goalsintegerHome team: power-play goals the team scored in the game.
home_short_handed_instancesintegerHome team: times the team played short-handed in the game.
home_short_handed_goalsintegerHome team: short-handed goals the team scored in the game.
home_expected_goalsnumericHome team: expected goals (xG) for the team in the game, from Liiga's undocumented model.
home_rankingintegerHome team: table position.
home_game_start_date_timecharacterHome team: scheduled start, ISO 8601 UTC.
home_logos_dark_bgcharacterHome team: logo image URL for dark backgrounds.
home_logos_light_bgcharacterHome team: logo image URL for light backgrounds.
home_logos_dark_bg_originalcharacterHome team: original-file logo URL for dark backgrounds; null in every capture.
home_logos_light_bg_originalcharacterHome team: original-file logo URL for light backgrounds; null in every capture.
away_team_idintegerAway team id (the number of the <num>:<slug> key).
away_team_slugcharacterAway team slug (e.g. tps).
away_placeholdercharacterAway team: placeholder label for an undecided playoff team, else null.
away_namecharacterAway team: display name of the team, e.g. HPK.
away_goalsintegerAway team: goals scored by the team in the game.
away_time_outintegerAway team: second of the game (from game start) at which the team called its timeout.
away_powerplay_instancesintegerAway team: power plays the team had in the game.
away_powerplay_goalsintegerAway team: power-play goals the team scored in the game.
away_short_handed_instancesintegerAway team: times the team played short-handed in the game.
away_short_handed_goalsintegerAway team: short-handed goals the team scored in the game.
away_expected_goalsnumericAway team: expected goals (xG) for the team in the game, from Liiga's undocumented model.
away_rankingintegerAway team: table position.
away_game_start_date_timecharacterAway team: scheduled start, ISO 8601 UTC.
away_logos_dark_bgcharacterAway team: logo image URL for dark backgrounds.
away_logos_light_bgcharacterAway team: logo image URL for light backgrounds.
away_logos_dark_bg_originalcharacterAway team: original-file logo URL for dark backgrounds; null in every capture.
away_logos_light_bg_originalcharacterAway team: original-file logo URL for light backgrounds; null in every capture.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
